question: Which of the following is an organic compound?
solution:
The correct answer is __**C₂H₆ (Ethane)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Organic compounds** are chemical compounds primarily composed of **carbon** and **hydrogen**, often with other elements like oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur, or phosphorus.
 
• **C₂H₆** (Ethane) is a simple organic compound that belongs to the category of hydrocarbons, specifically an alkane, which contains only carbon (C) and hydrogen (H) atoms. Hence, C₂H₆ is an organic compound.
 
• In contrast, compounds like **NaCl**, **CaCO₃**, and **Na₂CO₃** are considered **inorganic compounds** because they do not fit the typical structure of organic molecules with carbon-hydrogen bonds.
 
• **Ethane** is a gaseous compound under standard conditions and is a component of natural gas. It is used as a **fuel** and a **feedstock** in the chemical industry.
 
• Organic compounds like ethane are essential in **biological processes** and industrial applications, making them a key focus in chemistry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NaCl (Sodium Chloride):**

 
 
• **NaCl** is an **inorganic compound** commonly known as table salt.
 
• It consists of sodium (Na) and chlorine (Cl) ions arranged in a crystalline lattice.
 
• It is widely used in **cooking, food preservation, and industrial applications**.
 
 
 
• **CaCO₃ (Calcium Carbonate):**
 
 
• **CaCO₃** is an inorganic compound found naturally as limestone, chalk, and marble.
 
• It is used in **construction materials, cement, and as a dietary calcium supplement**.
 
• While it contains carbon, it lacks the C-H bonds required to classify it as an organic compound.
 
 
 
• **Na₂CO₃ (Sodium Carbonate):**
 
 
• **Na₂CO₃**, also known as soda ash or washing soda, is an inorganic compound.
 
• It is widely used in the **glass manufacturing industry, water treatment, and as a cleaning agent**.
 
• It contains carbonate ions (CO₃²⁻) but does not belong to organic compounds because of the absence of C-H bonds.
 
 
 
• **Organic Compounds:**
 
 
• **Organic chemistry** focuses on compounds containing **carbon-hydrogen (C-H) bonds**.
 
• Examples of organic compounds include **methane (CH₄), ethane (C₂H₆), glucose (C₆H₁₂O₆), and ethanol (C₂H₅OH)**.
 
• They play an essential role in **life processes, fuels, medicines, and industrial products**.
 
 
 
• **Inorganic Compounds:**
 
 
• These compounds include salts, oxides, and other substances that do not have C-H bonds, such as **water (H₂O), carbon dioxide (CO₂), and NaCl**.
 
• They are crucial for various applications like **construction, agriculture, and chemical synthesis**.
